title: Tech S and T- TechStrategy-Senior Manager-GDSF04
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Title Strategy Senior Manager**
**THE OPPORTUNITY:** 
 EY's Technology Strategy \& Transformation (TST) team is at the forefront of delivering cutting\-edge consulting and advisory services to some of the largest enterprises across the globe. Our technology practice is recognized by industry analysts as a leader in leveraging business and technology to drive strategic business\-led, tech\-enabled e2e transformation. We serve clients across all major industries and work with organizations of different sizes, helping guide them to achieve business success while delivering strategic IT value.
   

  

**Scope of engagements**
 We are currently seeking experienced, seasoned IT Strategy practitioners who can be positioned at the crucial intersection of business, technology and customer to devise creative new strategies based on trends, insights and data. We are looking for folks who have experience in advising clients to …
   

  

* reset, reimagine and re\-think their business and operating models with tech\-enabled, cutting\-edge solutions that re\-energize performance across the enterprise
* set and drive enterprise tech vision and strategy in alignment with corporate / business unit strategy, customer focus and solution teams
* drive increased value from technology spend with focus on optimizing cost, agility, productivity and performance


 We work with clients to address issues of importance to the Chief Information Officer (CIO) and Chief Technology Officer (CTO) in creating value and delivering world\-class IT capabilities to support futuristic business needs. Working closely with our industry groups and leveraging the Ernst \& Young brand as independent, trusted advisors, we provide our high\-profile clients with range of services including:
   

  

* 
+ Tech Strategy \& Vision
+ IT Operating Model optimization
+ Transformation strategy, roadmaps \& blueprints
+ Office of CIO functions (IT Finance, Sourcing, Project Portfolio Mgt. etc)
+ Product strategy \& management
+ M\&A due\-diligence, planning and post integration/separation
+ Enterprise Architecture Services


**Key responsibilities of candidate include:**
* Understanding the business strategy \& vision and translating them into enterprise\-wide technology vision \& strategy in alignment with strategic priorities for growth, customer experience, efficiency etc.
* Analyze value chain and business capabilities to develop clear understanding of strategic objectives, KPI’s, processes and underlying systems that deliver the business outcomes
* Assess the impact of the business strategy on business capability model and business processes to identify optimization opportunities (through tech\-enabled solutions) across organization, systems, data, infrastructure and applications
* Have strong experience in analysing business models, business model innovation/ incubation, and experience in one or more of the following areas preferred: Market Strategy, Pricing/ Monetization, Finance, Ecosystem Management, and/ or Product Management
* Ability to analyse client’s (IT) Operating Model including the organization structure, processes and governance while developing recommendations and/or creating actionable roadmaps
* Significant experience in: 1\) developing business capability model for the enterprise; 2\) analysing enterprise\-wide portfolio of systems / platforms and 3\) function as guardian of the transformation strategy and business architecture to make sure that new initiatives comply with strategic priorities
* Solid experience in guiding our clients through large, enterprise\-wide transformation to implement their strategies and business architecture. Experience working with IT leadership (e.g., CIO, IT Director) and business leadership (e.g., CFO, COO, BU leader, etc.) to help shape and guide the IT strategic and improvement agenda
* Be a trusted advisor on 'innovation' with ability to frame key business and technology trends within the context of the client's objectives. Ability to identify the potential implications and impacts of the associated trends.
* Leverage EY’s global network, and leverage the cross\-functional expertise to develop relevant architecture insights


**Within the team, your role will include the following additional responsibilities:**
* Ability to lead conversations with the client stakeholders. Strong communication skills as the profile requires interactions with CIO, CEO, CFO and other senior leadership
* Build and develop trusted relationships as a strategic technology advisor with clients and work internally across EY advisory teams to bring our clients the most comprehensive, end\-to\-end services and effectively address their business challenges.
* Building and growing TST Strategy practice, developing and maintaining client relationships, and selling and delivering work as an engagement leader or Subject Matter Specialist.
* Develop thought leadership and define approaches to provide structured solutions to complex technology strategy problems of clients, by recombining existing methodologies and teams
* Managing engagement teams and providing leadership in the assessment, design, and management of successful Business \- IT transformation engagements in collaboration with our clients. They should provide high quality client services by directing daily progress of engagement work, informing EY leadership of engagement status, and managing staff performance
* Help recruit, develop and retain strategy professionals, coach and mentor team members, deliver architecture\-related training and take on other practice management tasks as needed (e.g., development of practice offerings)
* Should be very good at using various tools (Such as Word, Excel, Powerpoint, visualization tools, MS\-Project, etc.)
* Would support in developing new solution offerings, tools and knowledge repositories
* People skill has worked independently on projects or as part of small consulting teams
* Should be self\-driven and organized person with ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, high pressure environment
* Should have experience in pursuit teams including conceptualizing propositions and presenting solutions to client
* Create expert content for point\-of\-view and use advanced presentation, public speaking, content creation and communication skills for C\-Level discussions.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of a specific industry, client or technology and function as an expert to advise senior leadership.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Strong academic background with BE/B.tech and MBA from top Tier\-1 B\-schools
* A background in Strategy Consulting (in top tier consulting firms), with 15\+ years of relevant experience in large\-scale, enterprise\-wide transformations
* 15\+ years of specific industry / sector experience through completed client engagements related to business transformation. Should have experience in any one or two industry sectors such as Financial services, Retail, Healthcare/Pharma, Telecom, e\-commerce, etc.
* Demonstrated experience of driving business workshops as well as conducting deep\-dive technology workshops to collaboratively develop transformation vision, strategy, roadmaps and blueprints
* Experience with assessing maturity of IT operating models \& organizations structure to determine optimization opportunities. Should understand IT \- business alignment, IT strategy and planning, development of current and future state IT architecture, roadmaps, IT/Digital maturity assessment, etc.
* Experience with large transformation related to customer experience, process re\-engineering, digital, cloud, automation, AI/ML/advanced analytics, next\-gen / emerging tech (IoT, blockchain, virtual twins etc).
* Conducting research and analyses of operational effectiveness, processes, stakeholders, etc., creating end\-to\-end visibility into how the organization executes their operations today and identifying systemic issues impacting business performance
* Should have experience in designing and managing an effective IT governance framework across the spectrum of IT service delivery
* Should be able to analyze data and translate findings into meaningful insights, integrating relevant business knowledge
* Should have knowledge about or exposure to areas such as IT Service Management and Governance, Agile methodologies, Data visualization, Cloud technologies, emerging technologies


**The following are preferred, but not required:**
* Advanced business and/or technology degrees from tier\-1 schools (MBA, Masters)
* Experience in presenting directly to the C\-Suite and explain complex concepts to anyone from an intern to a CFO, CHRO or CMO
* Experience working with IT leadership (e.g., CIO, IT Director) and business leadership (e.g., CFO, COO, BU leader, etc.) to help shape and guide the strategic and improvement agenda.
* Speaking at industry conferences, round tables, and other public forums
* Authoring articles and white papers
* Business / technology innovation experience with emerging tech solutions leveraging power of combinatorial technologies AI/ML, Data Automation, Blockchain, IoT, etc
* Exposure across key technology domains is preferred (application, data, DevOps, infrastructure, cloud, network. security etc)
* Demonstrated capability to drive sales and bring a network of client relationships to the firm
* Relevant industry certification (e.g., TOGAF Biz Architect, Business Process Framework (eTOM Practitioner of TMForum), AWS Cloud Certified etc.).


**Overall Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Understanding of the current IT environment and industry IT trends to identify the engagement and client service issues.
* Ability to act as day\-to\-day client contact on the project engagement; run client status and other client meetings and deliver executive\-level presentations that drive actions and decisions.
* Proven delivery skills including the ability to scope/size a project; staff a team with the appropriate skill set; provide subject matter direction and guidance to a team; and manage the delivery of an engagement.
* Ability to identify opportunities and help generate sell\-on work during client engagements by understanding a range services and offerings and coordinating with personnel in other service lines to help sell integrated solutions that meet client needs.
* Experience in creating points of view on relevant industry trends, solutions, methodologies, and analytical frameworks and tools to bring strategic perspectives to existing solutions.
* Experience in managing a portfolio of executive level clients and developing long\-term trusted advisor relationships.
* Experience in building strong teams with a solid understanding of project management, industry content knowledge, and effective client communications.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Project Manager
description:
At Turner \& Townsend we’re passionate about making the difference. That means delivering better outcomes for our clients, helping our people to realize their potential, and doing our part to create a prosperous society.
   

  





 Every day we help our major global clients deliver ambitious and highly technical projects, in over 130 countries worldwide.
   

  





 Our team is dynamic, innovative and client\-focused, supported by an inclusive and fun company culture. Our clients value our proactive approach, depth of expertise, integrity and the quality we deliver. As a result our people get to enjoy working on some of the most exciting projects in the world.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 Job Summary
   

  





 We are looking for an experienced and proactive
 **Project Manager** 
 to lead and deliver projects from initiation through completion. The ideal candidate will be responsible for planning, executing, monitoring, and closing projects while ensuring adherence to scope, budget, quality, and timelines. The role requires strong stakeholder management, leadership, risk mitigation, and cross\-functional coordination skills.
   

  





 Key Responsibilities
   

  





 Project Planning \& Execution
   

  




* Define project scope, objectives, timelines, deliverables, and resource requirements.
* Develop detailed project plans and monitor progress against established milestones.
* Ensure successful execution of projects within budget, quality, and schedule requirements.
* Coordinate project activities across multiple departments and stakeholders.



 Stakeholder Management
   

  




* Act as the primary point of contact for project stakeholders, clients, vendors, and internal teams.
* Conduct regular project review meetings and provide status updates to leadership.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and resolve project\-related issues effectively.



 Risk \& Change Management
   

  




* Identify potential project risks and develop mitigation strategies.
* Manage project changes, scope adjustments, and resource allocation.
* Proactively address project challenges to minimize impact on deliverables.



 Team Leadership
   

  




* Lead and motivate cross\-functional project teams to achieve project objectives.
* Assign responsibilities, track performance, and provide guidance to team members.
* Foster collaboration and ensure effective communication among project participants.



 Budget \& Resource Management
   

  




* Prepare project budgets and manage project expenditures.
* Optimize resource utilization to ensure cost\-effective project execution.
* Monitor project costs and ensure adherence to approved budgets.



 Quality \& Compliance
   

  




* Ensure projects comply with organizational standards, regulatory requirements, and quality guidelines.
* Conduct project audits and reviews to ensure successful delivery.
* Maintain project documentation, reports, and records.



 Vendor \& Contractor Management
   

  




* Coordinate with suppliers, contractors, and external partners.
* Evaluate vendor performance and ensure contractual obligations are met.
* Support procurement and commercial negotiations where required.


**Qualifications**

 Required Qualifications
   

  




* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Management, Construction Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 8\-12 years of experience in project management, including end\-to\-end project delivery.
* Proven track record of managing medium to large\-scale projects.
* Experience in Manufacturing, Construction, Infrastructure, Engineering, Energy, IT, Telecom, or related industries.


**Additional Information**

 Turner \& Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.
   

  





 Please find out more about us at www.turnerandtownsend.com
   

  





  

  





 Join our social media conversations for more information about Turner \& Townsend and our exciting future projects:
   

  





 Twitter
   

  





 Instagram
   

  





 LinkedIn

title: Project Manager
description:
We are looking for a hands\-on Project Manager with 4\-5 years of experience driving technical programs within engineering teams. The ideal candidate has strong command of SDLC processes, is fluent with Atlassian tooling, and has a track record of managing stakeholders across product, engineering, and senior leadership. This role requires someone who can run day\-to\-day program management with an agentic, ownership\-driven mindset — proactively identifying risks, unblocking teams, and reporting on productivity without needing constant direction.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 

 •
 
**SDLC \& Program Delivery:** 

 Plan, manage, and drive execution of technical programs across the full SDLC — from requirements and design through development, testing, release, and post\-launch support.
 





  •
 
**Technical Program Management:** 

 Own sprint planning, backlog grooming support, release schedules, and cross\-team dependency tracking for engineering programs. 
 





 •
 
**Atlassian Tooling:** 

 Configure, maintain, and drive adoption of Jira, Confluence, and related Atlassian tools for project tracking, workflows, dashboards, and documentation. 
 





 •
 
**Stakeholder Management:** 

 Partner closely with product managers, engineering leads, and senior leadership to align on priorities, timelines, trade\-offs, and status; run steering/status meetings and executive updates.
 





  •
 
**Productivity Reporting:** 

 Track, analyze, and report team and program productivity metrics (velocity, cycle time, throughput, sprint predictability) and translate them into actionable insights for leadership.
 





  •
 
**Risk Management:** 

 Proactively identify, log, and mitigate program and delivery risks; maintain risk registers and drive timely resolution of blockers and issues. 
 





 •
 
**Agentic Program Ops:** 

 Independently manage day\-to\-day program operations — standups, follow\-ups, documentation, and coordination — with an agentic, self\-driven approach that minimizes hand\-holding. 
 





 •
 
**Documentation \& Reporting:** 

 Maintain clear, up\-to\-date program documentation, RAID logs, roadmaps, and status reports accessible to all stakeholders.
 





  •
 
**Process Improvement:** 

 Identify opportunities to streamline SDLC processes, tooling, and reporting to improve team efficiency and delivery predictability. 
 




  





**Required Qualifications \& Experience** 

 • 4\-5 years of experience in project/program management, with a significant portion managing technical programs for engineering teams. 
 





 • Strong working knowledge of SDLC methodologies (Agile/Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid models). 
 





 • Hands\-on, day\-to\-day experience with Atlassian tools (Jira, Confluence), including dashboard and workflow configuration.
 





 • Demonstrated experience managing stakeholders across product, technology, and senior leadership, including running executive\-level updates. 
 





 • Proven ability to define, track, and report productivity and delivery metrics (velocity, burndown, cycle time, throughput). 
 





 • Solid grounding in risk identification, tracking, and mitigation for technical programs. 
 





 • Demonstrated ability to manage day\-to\-day program activities independently and proactively, with minimal supervision. 
 





 • Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting to senior leadership.
 





 • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Principal Program Manager
description:
**At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.**
**Job Description: Project Manager (T4\)**
**Position:** 
 Principal Program Manager— Level T4
   

  

**Function:** 
 Engineering / Program Management — EDA Software Development
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are looking for a seasoned Project Manager to lead and coordinate complex, high\-stakes initiatives across multiple engineering and business teams in the context of
 **Electronic Design Automation (EDA) software development** 
 . You will be the central orchestrator ensuring delivery excellence, stakeholder alignment, and continuous innovation across the full EDA product lifecycle.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Multi\-team coordination: Drive alignment across cross\-functional teams (engineering, QA, design, operations, business) to ensure seamless execution and on\-time delivery of EDA software projects.
* Customer project ownership: Manage end\-to\-end delivery of customer\-facing EDA projects, acting as the primary point of contact and ensuring commitments are met with quality.
* High\-stakes project leadership: Lead critical, high\-visibility programs with significant business or technical impact, managing risks proactively and escalating appropriately.
* Structured planning: Define project scope, milestones, dependencies, and resource plans using rigorous methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid).
* Innovation facilitation: Champion new approaches and continuously explore emerging tools — including AI\-assisted project management (intelligent scheduling, risk prediction, automated reporting, and AI\-driven decision support) — to improve team efficiency and project outcomes.
* Status reporting: Provide clear, concise, and accurate communication to all stakeholders — from engineers to senior leadership.
* Team collaboration: Foster a strong team spirit, removing blockers and ensuring every contributor feels supported and empowered.


**Required Profile**
* Proven track record managing complex, multi\-team programs in a technical or software development environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to adapt messaging for both technical and executive audiences.
* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and structured in approach.
* Collaborative mindset with genuine team spirit — you succeed when the team succeeds.
* Comfortable operating under pressure and navigating ambiguity on high\-stakes deliverables.
* Experience with project management tools (Jira, Confluence, MS Project, or equivalent).
* Understanding of EDA tools and the semiconductor design flow is a strong plus — familiarity with the domain (simulation, synthesis, place \& route, verification, etc.) enables faster ramp\-up and more credible engagement with engineering teams.
* PMP certification (Project Management Professional) is a strong plus — it demonstrates mastery of globally recognized PM standards and a commitment to the discipline.


**What We Value**
 You are not just a process enforcer — you are a builder of bridges between teams, a guardian of commitments to customers, and a driver of a culture where quality and innovation go hand in hand. You embrace AI as a force multiplier to manage smarter, not just harder — and you bring enough EDA domain awareness to speak the language of the engineers you serve.
   

  

**We’re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can’t.**

title: Senior Construction Manager
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 Responsable des activités liées à la construction, à l'élaboration et à la mise en service sur le site du client, de la mobilisation du site aux travaux de génie civil, de montage et de mise en service, en passant par les activités de gestion liées à ce domaine. Agit sur la capacité de l'équipe à atteindre les objectifs en matière de service, de qualité et de respect des délais. Ce rôle est soumis aux objectifs de la politique opérationnelle. Il dispose d'une autonomie modérée. Des niveaux élevés de discernement opérationnel sont nécessaires pour obtenir les résultats escomptés.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Rôles et responsabilités**
* Activités liées aux travaux de génie civil au cours de la phase ITO et/ou OTR, sous la direction du responsable du site. Peut diriger d'autres personnes directement ou indirectement et/ou parrainer des sous\-contractants.
* Nécessite des connaissances spécialisées de la fonction. Influe sur l'élaboration d'une stratégie dans son domaine de responsabilité, y compris sur le contrôle des ressources et sur la formulation des politiques.
* Interprète les enjeux commerciaux internes et externes simples et recommande des meilleures pratiques pour améliorer les produits, processus ou services. Reste informé des tendances de l'industrie susceptibles d'éclairer son travail.
* Fait preuve d'un haut niveau de discernement pour prendre des décisions, et gérer des tâches ou des problèmes complexes dans les domaines de l'exploitation, de la gestion des produits, de la fabrication, de la technologie ou de l'ingénierie. Possède la capacité d'évaluer la qualité des informations fournies et sait poser des questions pertinentes aux parties prenantes. Est capable de résoudre des problèmes avec des solutions innovantes qui sortent du cadre des paramètres établis, mais aussi d'élaborer des recommandations. Fait appel à des ressources internes et externes en dehors de sa propre fonction pour l'aider à prendre une décision.
* Dirige, s'il y a lieu, des équipes fonctionnelles ou des projets dont les besoins en ressources, les risques et/ou la complexité sont réduits. Exprime des concepts difficiles et peut influencer les opinions de ses collègues sur des sujets particuliers. Peut amener autrui à envisager une question selon un point de vue différent.


**Qualifications De Base**
* 
* Pour les rôles en dehors des États\-Unis \- Ce rôle nécessite une expérience avancée de la fonction et de la station de travail audio numérique. Connaissances de niveau équivalent à une maîtrise dans une université accréditée (ou un baccalauréat avec une expérience dans un domaine pertinent).
* Pour les rôles aux États\-Unis \- Maîtrise d'une université accrédité (ou diplôme d'études secondaires et/ou diplôme d'étude général avec au moins 6 ans d'expérience dans la fonction).


**Caractéristiques souhaitées**
* Solides compétences en communication orale et écrite. Solides compétences relationnelles et de leadership. Capacité démontrée d'analyse et de résolution des problèmes. Capacité démontrée à diriger des programmes/projets. Capacité à documenter, planifier, lancer et exécuter des programmes. Compétences établies en gestion de projet.Remarque : Pour se conformer aux exigences légales américaines en matière d'immigration et autres, il est nécessaire de préciser le nombre minimum d'années d'expérience requis pour tout poste basé aux États\-Unis. Pour les rôles en dehors des États\-Unis, pour assurer la conformité avec la législation applicable, les juristes doivent mentionner le niveau d'expérience requis et non PAS un nombre minimum d'années.Cette description de poste a pour but de fournir un guide détaillé du rôle. Toutefois, il n'est pas prévu de modifier ou de restreindre et/ou d'élargir de quelque manière que ce soit les tâches requises de chaque employé, telles qu'elles sont définies dans leur contrat de travail respectif et/ou convenues d'un commun accord entre un employé et son responsable.


******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:** 
 Yes

title: Delivery Manager
description:
Job Description:
   

  

  


 The Delivery Manager will report to the Director of Operations India and support the successful delivery of Rightsline implementation, upgrade, and advancement projects. The role combines hands\-on project delivery, customer engagement, project governance, and people management responsibilities. The individual will lead a small team of Delivery Leads while ensuring successful execution of customer projects, proactive risk management, and high\-quality service delivery. 
 


  

 Key Responsibilities:
   


  

  

  




  


 • Manage and mentor a team of Delivery Leads, providing guidance, coaching, workload prioritization, and performance feedback.
 


  


 • Oversee multiple concurrent implementation and advancement projects.
 


  


 • Create, maintain, and monitor project plans, milestones, risks, dependencies, and status reports.
 


  


 • Act as the first level escalation point for project delivery issues and coordinate resolutions with leadership.
 


  


 • Monitor project health, delivery KPIs, customer commitments, and implementation timelines.
 


  


 • Facilitate project governance, customer status meetings, and internal delivery reviews.
 


  


 • Partner with Solutions, Product, QA, and Enablement teams to ensure successful project execution.
 


  


 • Manage project scope, change requests, and delivery risks.
 


  


 • Track billable and non\-billable utilization, project progress, and delivery milestones.
 


  


 • Support continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to delivery best practices.
 


  


 • Coordinate with third\-party vendors and integration partners where required.
 


  

  
* **Collaborate with cross\-functional teams**
  
* **Ensure compliance with ISO 27001, SOC 1, SOC 2 frameworks**
  


  






  

 What You Bring:
   


 • Bachelor’s degree in business, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline.
 


  


 • 5–8 years of experience in SaaS implementations, Professional Services, Project Management, Delivery Management, or Customer Success environments.
 


  


 • Minimum 2 years of experience leading or mentoring project teams.
 


  


 • Experience managing multiple customer\-facing software implementation projects.
 


  


 • Strong stakeholder management and customer communication skills.
 


  


 • Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving abilities.
 


  


 • Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
 


  


 • Experience with Agile or Hybrid Agile delivery methodologies.
 


  


 • Jira project management experience preferred.
 


  


 • PMP, Prince2, Scrum Master, or equivalent certifications preferred.
 


  


 • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.
 


  


  

  

  




  

 Success Measures:
   


 • On\-time delivery of assigned projects
 


  


 • Customer satisfaction and stakeholder feedback
 


  


 • Effective management of project risks and escalations
 


  


 • Team performance and delivery quality
 


  


 • Successful execution of multiple concurrent implementations
 


  


  

  

  




  

 Work Environment \& Expectations:
   

  
* Noida/NCR based
  
* Demonstrates flexibility to work in required shifts.
  
* Compliance with security and remote working policies
  


  


  

  

  




  

 Compensation \& Growth:
   


 Competitive compensation aligned to market standards with strong career growth opportunities.
 


  


  

  

  




  

 Life at Rightsline India:
   


 At our India operations, we foster a culture of inclusiveness, accountability, and innovation. We believe in empowering our teams to take ownership, drive impact, and contribute meaningfully to global success. We offer a structured yet flexible work environment that balances performance with employee well\-being. Our benefits framework for India includes:
 


  

  
* Provident Fund, Gratuity, and all statutory benefits in compliance with applicable Indian labour laws
  
* Comprehensive Group Medical Insurance covering employees and their eligible dependents
  
* Group Personal Accident Insurance for enhanced financial security
  
* In\-office meal benefits, including sponsored breakfast, lunch, and evening snacks
  
* Hybrid work model with clearly defined collaboration days
  
* Flexible working hours, role\-dependent
  
* Structured and transparent leave policy
  
* Career growth and advancement opportunities within a rapidly scaling global SaaS organization
  
* Continuous learning, upskilling, and leadership development support
  
* Quarterly employee engagement initiatives, along with celebrations and recognition programs
  


  


 You will work alongside a globally connected team with strong leadership support and collaborative cross\-functional exposure. We encourage proactive thinking, ownership, and initiative—ideas are welcomed, and execution is supported. As a people\-first organization, we are committed to building a high\-performance culture where growth, accountability, and innovation go hand in hand.
 


  


  

  

  




  

 Hiring Process:
   

  
* HR Screening

TheHireHub.AI values innovation, efficiency, empowerment, and an inclusive workplace culture. This role offers close exposure to the founders and the opportunity to contribute directly to company\-building initiatives across strategy, operations, research, customer\-facing work, and execution.

 The Founder’s Office Associate will work closely with the founders to drive strategic, operational, and cross\-functional priorities for TheHireHub.AI. The role is designed for a skilled early\-career professional who can move comfortably between research, planning, execution, communication, and problem\-solving. You will help the founders organize priorities, prepare business insights, coordinate stakeholders, and ensure important initiatives move forward with speed and clarity. Success in this role means creating leverage for the founders, improving execution quality, and converting loosely defined opportunities into completed outcomes. The ideal candidate communicates confidently, manages multiple workstreams without losing detail, and takes ownership from start to finish. This is a high\-exposure role suited to someone who enjoys variety, learns quickly, handles ambiguity, and wants to understand how an AI recruitment software company is built and scaled.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own founder\-led projects from problem definition through execution, using structured plans, milestones, and stakeholder follow\-ups to deliver timely business outcomes.
* Prepare market, customer, competitor, and business research that helps the founders evaluate opportunities, refine priorities, and make informed decisions.
* Coordinate cross\-functional initiatives across product, sales, marketing, operations, and customer conversations, maintaining clear ownership and momentum.
* Build concise presentations, business updates, operating documents, and decision briefs that improve alignment and accelerate founder\-level decision\-making.
* Track key priorities, action items, and dependencies through reliable systems, escalating risks early and ensuring commitments are closed.
* Support customer, partner, and internal communication by preparing context, managing follow\-ups, and representing the company with professionalism and clarity.
* Identify recurring operational gaps and implement lightweight processes, templates, and dashboards that improve execution consistency as the company grows.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Strong verbal and written communication, with the ability to simplify complex information, present clear recommendations, and interact confidently with founders, customers, and stakeholders.

* Comfortable using productivity, documentation, presentation, spreadsheet, project\-management, and collaboration tools to organize information and create visibility.



  





**What You'll Bring** 




 You bring 1–4 years of experience in a Founder’s Office or a comparable role involving business operations, strategy, project execution, or cross\-functional coordination. You communicate clearly in writing and conversation, organize information well, and can adapt your message for founders, customers, and internal teams. You are comfortable handling several priorities at once while maintaining accuracy, responsiveness, and follow\-through. You do not wait for perfect instructions; you clarify the objective, structure the problem, propose a path forward, and keep stakeholders informed. You can move between detailed execution and broader business context, understanding how individual tasks connect to company outcomes. You are skilled with common workplace tools for documents, presentations, spreadsheets, research, communication, and task tracking. You bring sound judgment, curiosity, discretion, and a bias toward action. Most importantly, you take ownership of outcomes rather than limiting yourself to assigned activities, and you are motivated by the opportunity to work closely with founders while helping build an ambitious AI recruitment software company.
 



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Work closely with the founders and gain broad exposure to strategy, operations, product, customers, and company\-building decisions from an early stage.

**What We Offer** 



* Direct exposure to founders and meaningful ownership across strategic and operational initiatives in an AI\-powered recruitment software company.
* A high\-learning, cross\-functional environment where strong performance creates opportunities to take on broader responsibilities and influence company\-building priorities.
* The opportunity to work from the Noida office with a focused early\-stage team and contribute to products shaping modern recruitment workflows.

title: ECMS-DCS Project Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**
 You will be responsible for the full project lifecycle, from requirements gathering and concept design to hardware/software engineering, simulation, testing, and commissioning.
   

  

 Project Engineering:
   

  

* Review project inputs from customer meetings, site surveys, and technical documents
* Lead engineering for DCS\-based ECMS and data\-center projects
* Develop network architectures, control logic, protection schemes, and procurement specifications for ECMS and Hybrid EMS
* Engineer software logic for load shedding, MW and MVAr sharing, grid tie\-ins, synchronization, islanding, and black start functions
* Integrate LV, MV, and HV electrical distribution systems, including switchgear, substations, GIS, and switchyards
* Implement control logic based on SAMA diagrams and functional descriptions
* Develop breaker control macros, faceplate templates, and simulation logic
* Configure third\-party communication protocols and interfaces, including Modbus, OPC, IEC 61850, and DNP3
* Lead point database development, I/O list extraction, and hardware/software integration
* Prepare and review system architecture, GA drawings, and network topology documents
* Ensure compliance with IEEE, IEC, NEC, and applicable regional grid codes
* Maintain ISO\-compliant Quality and HSE documentation and procedures
* Coordinate with system integrators to support timely, cost\-effective, and high\-quality delivery
* Support utilization tracking and management reporting, including MORs


 Field Services:
   

  

* Prepare site execution plans in coordination with the project manager
* Lead the site team during Ovation system power\-up, redundancy checks, and I/O testing
* Maintain procedures for loop checks, device checks, and panel charging
* Lead site testing and troubleshooting for analog and binary devices
* Coordinate with customers and vendors on commissioning issues, progress updates, risks, and roadblocks
* Troubleshoot network and communication interfaces, including OPC, Modbus, DNP3, serial links, and IEC 61850
* Perform loop and device checks and implement required updates to logic, graphics, and databases based on site or customer requirements
* Work closely with the engineering team to troubleshoot hardware and software issues, including controllers, modules, and link modules
* Commission ECMS systems for commercial operation
* Manage customer\-facing activities and prepare site reports
* Coordinate with vendors and front offices to support site execution


**Who You Are:**
 You should be able to assume responsibility for the outcomes of others . Promotes a sense of urgency and establishes and enforces individual accountability in the team. You should be able to deliver messages in a clear, compelling, and concise manner. Actively listens and checks for understanding. Sets aggressive goals and has high standards. You should be consistently one of the top performers. Pursues everything with energy, drive, and the need to finish as per business needs.
   

  

**For This Role, You Will Need:**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical, electronics, instrumentation, or power engineering.
* 8–16 years of experience in the electrical industry or with a DCS/PLC OEM or vendor, preferably in captive power plants or refineries, with knowledge of DCS/PLC programming, engineering, and commissioning.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in teams.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and perform well under pressure.
* Proficiency in report writing and business communication.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with vendors and subcontractors.
* Familiarity with relevant industry standards, including NEC, IEEE, IEC, and OSHA.
* Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, single\-line diagrams, and technical manuals.
* Willingness to work in industrial environments while following all required safety protocols.
* Willingness to travel to project sites across India and internationally, as required.


**Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:**
* Strong knowledge of electrical distribution systems, substations, GIS, and switchyard operations.
* Proven experience in ECS software design, including load shedding and power sharing functions.
* Expert knowledge of electrical equipment, including switchboards, generators, turbines, AVRs, motors, transformers, capacitors, CTs, VTs, feeders, meters, and relays.
* Solid understanding of programming languages, preferably C or C\+\+.
* Experience with IEC 61850, Modbus, OPC UA, and other control system protocols over TCP/IP or serial communication.
* Experience with protective relays, substations, and renewable energy automation systems.
* Experience designing and configuring SEL RTAC and equivalent IED architectures.

We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives — because we know that great ideas come from great teams. We prioritize providing competitive benefits plans, a variety of medical insurance plans, Employee Assistance Program, employee resource groups, recognition, and much more. Our culture offers flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave.

**WHY EMERSON**
**Our Commitment to Our People**
 At Emerson, we are motivated by a spirit of collaboration that helps our diverse, multicultural teams across the world drive innovation that makes the world healthier, safer, smarter, and more sustainable. And we want you to join us in our bold aspiration.

You’ll contribute to this vital work while further developing your skills through our award\-winning employee development programs. We are a proud corporate citizen in every city where we operate and are committed to our people, our communities, and the world at large. We take this responsibility seriously and strive to make a positive impact through every endeavor.

title: Sr Prin Business Process Consultant
description:
**Why UKG**
 At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do.
   

  

 We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you.
   

  

**About the team: \-**
 Finance Digital Enablement exists to reimagine how Finance operates by combining process excellence, digital technologies, AI, automation, and data to build a simpler, smarter, and more scalable Finance organization.
   

  

 The AI and Automation team serves as a horizontal capability supporting Finance Global Process Owners and Business Owners across Record\-to\-Report, Procure\-to\-Pay, Order\-to\-Cash, and other Finance domains. The team identifies high\-value opportunities, designs intelligent business capabilities, manages the Finance AI and automation portfolio, establishes governance, and partners with IT to deliver secure, scalable, supportable, and measurable solutions.
   

  

**About the role: \-**
 Reporting to the VP Finance Digital Enablement, the role partners with Finance Global Process Owners, Business Owners, and IT to identify transformation opportunities, redesign processes, define functional requirements, and select the best combination of agentic AI, generative AI, machine learning, RPA, workflow, rules\-based automation, document intelligence, analytics, process redesign, or hybrid approaches. It leads major workstreams from identification through adoption and value realization, combining Finance and Accounting knowledge with AI and automation expertise, portfolio leadership, and the ability to turn emerging technology into scalable business capability.
   

  

**How you will make an impact: \-**
**Execute the Finance AI and Automation Strategy**
* Translate the multi\-year Finance AI and automation strategy into actionable roadmaps, programs, and workstreams.
* Help evolve Finance from primarily citizen\-led enablement toward a balanced delivery model that includes self\-service productivity use cases, guided solutions, and centrally built, process\- and system\-embedded capabilities. Ensure initiatives align with Finance priorities, enterprise AI standards, approved platforms, control requirements, and UKG’s broader technology strategy.


**Lead the Finance AI and Automation Portfolio**
* Manage a portfolio of AI and automation opportunities across multiple Finance domains, including Record\-to\-Report, Procure\-to\-Pay, Order\-to\-Cash, Tax, Treasury, and other functions.
* Establish disciplined practices for demand intake, opportunity assessment, prioritization, sequencing, business\-case development, delivery tracking, risk management, and value realization. Partner with Global Process Owners and Business Owners to evaluate strategic alignment, business value, process impact, control considerations, adoption requirements, and readiness, while collaborating with the IT AI team to assess technical feasibility, architecture implications, delivery complexity, support needs, and opportunities for reuse.


**Partner with Finance Global Process Owners**
* Work closely with the RTR, PTP, OTC, and future Global Process Owners to translate process roadmaps into prioritized AI and automation opportunities.
* Facilitate process\-discovery and future\-state\-design sessions, challenge existing ways of working, identify opportunities to eliminate manual effort, improve controls, strengthen user experience, and create more intelligent end\-to\-end processes. Identify common patterns and capabilities that can be reused across Finance instead of creating isolated point solutions.
* Lead Functional Solution Design


**Lead functional solution design**
* In collaboration with Finance stakeholders and the IT AI team, determine whether the most effective solution should use agentic AI, generative AI, machine learning, RPA, workflow, rules\-based automation, document processing, analytics, process redesign, or a hybrid approach. Define user journeys, business rules, decision points, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, exception handling, data requirements, success measures, and adoption needs.


**Advance Agentic and Embedded Finance Solutions**
* Lead the Finance functional design and implementation of centrally developed, process\-embedded, and agentic solutions.
* Help define agent roles, task orchestration, system interactions, decision logic, human oversight, escalation paths, exception management, monitoring, and ongoing business ownership. Partner with IT to move high\-value concepts from experimentation into governed production solutions that are secure, supportable, and embedded into Finance operating processes.


**Expand Automation Beyond AI**
* Apply the right technology to the problem rather than defaulting to AI. Evaluate RPA, workflow, APIs, machine learning, document processing, rules engines, process mining, and other automation options, including hybrid designs that improve control, reliability, scalability, and economics.


**Strengthen Governance and Responsible AI**
* Implement Finance AI and automation governance aligned with UKG’s enterprise standards for AI, security, data, privacy, legal, risk, and internal controls.
* Apply clear criteria for citizen\-led, guided, and centrally built solutions. Ensure financially significant, higher\-risk, or process\-embedded use cases receive appropriate business review, technical assessment, testing, control design, documentation, approval, monitoring, and support. Help create a governance model that enables innovation without compromising control, security, auditability, or long\-term supportability.


**Drive Adoption and Business Readiness**
* Partner with Business Owners and Transformation Delivery \& Enablement to ensure AI and automation initiatives are successfully adopted and embedded into day\-to\-day Finance operations.
* Define role changes, process impacts, training requirements, communications, readiness criteria, adoption measures, and operating procedures required to sustain new capabilities. Ensure implementation success is measured not only by technical deployment, but by actual usage, process improvement, and business outcomes.


**Lead Value Realization**
* Establish clear business cases, baselines, and performance measures for AI and automation investments.
* Track outcomes such as hours saved, cycle\-time reduction, improved accuracy, lower exception volumes, control effectiveness, employee experience, adoption, scalability, and financial value. Partner with Business Owners, GPOs, and IT to evaluate solution performance and identify opportunities to improve, expand, or retire capabilities based on realized value.


**Lead and Develop the Team**
* Lead and develop a team of AI, automation, process\-design, and transformation professionals.
* Set clear priorities, coach team members, review solution designs, and foster a culture that balances innovation and experimentation with governance, accountability, customer focus, and disciplined delivery. Build team capability in Finance transformation, agentic process design, automation discovery, functional architecture, portfolio management, change leadership, and value realization.


**Success Measures:\-**
 Success will be measured by the effective execution of the Finance AI and automation strategy and the delivery of measurable outcomes across multiple Finance domains.
   

  

* Health and quality of the AI and automation portfolio.
* Number and impact of governed, process\-embedded solutions deployed.
* Adoption and sustained usage of delivered capabilities.
* Productivity, cycle\-time, quality, and control improvements.
* Value realized versus approved business cases.
* Strength of collaboration across Global Process Owners, Business Owners, and the IT AI team.
* Effectiveness of Finance AI and automation governance.
* Reuse of common patterns and capabilities across Finance.
* Delivery predictability and stakeholder satisfaction.
* Development of Finance and team capability in AI, automation, and agentic process design.


**What Success Looks Like in the First 12–18 Months: \-**
* Establish a strong operating rhythm for Finance AI and automation portfolio execution, including intake, prioritization, governance, delivery tracking, and value realization.
* Build a prioritized pipeline of high\-value opportunities with the RTR, PTP, and OTC Global Process Owners.
* Lead multiple centrally built AI or automation use cases from discovery through implementation, adoption, and measurable value realization.
* Advance several process\-embedded or agentic use cases that demonstrate how Finance can move beyond standalone productivity tools toward more intelligent end\-to\-end processes.
* Establish consistent functional\-design standards for AI and automation, including human\-in\-the\-loop controls, exception handling, governance, monitoring, and business ownership.
* Improve coordination and ways of working across Finance Digital Enablement, Business Owners, Global Process Owners, the IT AI team, and Transformation Delivery \& Enablement.
* Implement clear portfolio reporting that provides transparency into priorities, delivery progress, risks, adoption, technical dependencies, and expected value.
* Develop reusable Finance AI and automation patterns that reduce time to design and accelerate future use\-case delivery.
* Demonstrate practical application of technologies beyond AI, including RPA, workflow, machine learning, document intelligence, and hybrid automation approaches.
* Strengthen Finance AI governance so that citizen\-led innovation can continue while higher\-risk or enterprise use cases transition into controlled and supported delivery models.
* Build and develop a high\-performing team capable of supporting agentic, AI\-enabled, and traditional automation initiatives.
* Establish credibility as a trusted advisor to Global Process Owners, Business Owners, and IT leaders on how emerging technologies can practically transform Finance and Accounting.


**Required Qualifications:\-**
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline; MBA, master’s degree, or relevant advanced certification preferred.

title: Lead Specialist - Logistics
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 Manage transportation and related logistics of goods and services to and from internal and/or external customers/suppliers.
   

  

 Impacts departmental operations and responsible for planning/execution.
   

  

 The project logistics specialist shall be responsible for ensuring that the specified scope (package/material) is completely delivered at the required destination, with safety and quality in good condition within the timeframe and the allocated budget. The role will also entail responsibility from tendering phase to project execution reporting to the logistics team leader.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities**
* Performs logistics costing during tender Inquiry to order (ITO) and project execution Order to remittance (OTR);
* Collects and analyses all data needed from the tender manager / Project team before sending the Request for Quotations to Transport Service Providers.
* Maintain and monitor a project logistics schedule in conjunction with PPLM (project procurement and logistics manager)
* Maintain a cadence of project logistics review/ meetings with project team members.
* Issues Request for Quotation (RFQ) to Transport Service Providers using the GE Vernova templates and following the GE Vernova sourcing rules.
* Analyses the offers, sends the clarification requests to the Service Providers and performs commercial negotiation.
* Ensures that all quotations are complete, compliant and received in due time.
* Presents the Techno commercial analysis to the Logistic Team Leader/ Regional Procurement \& Logistic Team Leader at ITO \& during OTR and highlight the logistics contingencies, risks and opportunities with the associated mitigation plan.
* Presents the technical analysis to the Bid manager (at ITO) / PPLM and Project team (during OTR), and highlight the logistics contingencies, risks and opportunities with the associated mitigation plan.
* Prepares the complete file to be submitted to Logistics Team leader for mentored negotiation when applicable.
* Drive all relevant stakeholders to ensure timely issuance of the Purchase requisition and purchase order to logistics providers during project execution.
* Issues the packing and marking instructions in due course and sends them to the Procurement team.
* Issues the relevant local procedures for importation and/or transport in collaboration with the local logistics team / customs CoE Team/appointed customs brokers, where required;
* Manages the delivery of equipment up to the place of destination within the schedule defined by the Project.
* Ensures that all shipping documents are properly issued and released timely with accuracy to stakeholders, so that the expected delivery date and payment date are met.
* Ensures that all the international trade regulations \& GE Vernova rules are fully respected before shipping.
* Updates the shipping progress report periodically and timely.
* Updates the Logistics cost follow\-up tool and advises immediately the PPLM and the logistics team leader in case of deviation during project execution.
* Monitors logistics Risks and Opportunities all along the project life and keep the PPLM and the logistics team leader informed of any change and/or new risk and opportunity.
* Ensures that Service Providers are duly informed about EHS rules and implement them.
* Ensures that the method statement for sensitive operations is issued in timely by the Service Provider, and ensure operations are carried out accordingly.
* Conducts Review Meetings with the Service Provider and share Minutes of Meeting with the PPLM and the logistics team leader.
* Deal with the Service Provider in case of minor deviations from transport contract specifications (non\-conformances) and report to the PPLM, Logistics team Leader \[and the Region procurement \& logistics leader in case of major or repeated deviation].
* Provides Service Provider performance feedback to logistics team Leader.
* Follow all logistics processes \& relevant tools usage.


**Required Qualifications**
* Degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Logistics and related field with a minimum of 10 years of relevant Project logistics experience in an engineering, Procurement \& Construction (EPC) environment within the Transmission \& Distribution, Power Generation, or Oil \& Gas industry.
* Logistics Management: Experience managing both inbound and outbound workflows.
* Specialized Cargo: Expertise in handling ODC (Over Dimension Cargo) and OWC (Overweight Cargo) in addition to general cargo.
* Industry Experience: A background in EPC project within the Energy, Oil \& Gas sectors.
* Compliance: Comprehensive knowledge of customs clearance processes
* Experience or knowledge in Project Management, Sourcing \& procurement and substation equipment.
* Demonstrated experience and confidence navigating in high matrix set\-up organization).
* Key Performance Indicators:
* Adhere to GEV’s principle of SQDC \~ safety always, and quality over delivery and cost.
* On\-time delivery of specified shipment as per project needs.
* On\-time release of shipping documents
* Savings and budget compliance.
* Accuracy and timeliness of reporting.
* Adherence to the global processes and IT Tools for transport sourcing and execution,
* Works as per GE Vernova’s the Spirit \& the Letter Compliance Rules


******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:** 
 Yes

 • You have experience developing people through coaching, training, performance management and career development.
   

  

**YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES** 
  

 • Lead and manage all construction aspects of responsible building projects from start to finish, ensuring safe, compliant, sustainable and innovative delivery.

 • Lead engagement with designers, contractors and partners to identify cost\-efficient and innovative project delivery solutions.
   

 • Work closely with Procurement and Engineering to define sourcing strategies, contractual models and effective design and construction methods.
   

 • Ensure project estimates, budgets, cost follow\-up, timelines and risk management are in place and aligned with investment requirements.

 • Ensure competent resources are available throughout all phases of construction projects and manage team competence, performance and succession planning.
   

 • Create an environment where IKEA culture is strong and embraces the diversity of co\-workers and customers.
   

  

**TOGETHER AS A TEAM** 
  

 Without us it would be difficult to meet our customers in person. In our team we find, develop and manage IKEA properties around the whole world. We look forward to receiving your application.

title: Team Lead - Software Development (DEX)
description:

With more than 1,900 employees worldwide, we celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each individual brings to the table and foster a dynamic work environment where new ideas thrive. Are you ready to join our team and make an impact?
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 The TeamViewer Digital Employee Experience (DEX) platform finds and resolves IT issues before they affect users. Over the past several years we have successfully built and released products which makes IT administrators' day\-to\-day life easier. Our vision is to become THE unified endpoint management solution for our customers.
   

  

 We’re looking for an experienced Team Lead in Software Development to manage and support our teams developing and enhancing our DEX capabilities, trusted by large enterprise customers. In this role, you’ll be essential to maintain a steady delivery cadence for the team, working with the different stakeholders (Product Management, Customer Support, Security, SRE) to ensure a clear prioritized Sprint backlog, and minimizing disruptions. You will translate high\-level vision into working services. You will communicate status clearly to all stakeholders, surfacing risks and impediments as they arise, and identifying ways forward – and escalating to leadership as needed. You will also coach and mentor your team members, guiding them in their personal and technical improvement, providing appropriate and timely feedback.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**
* Lead a cross\-functional engineering team which focuses on maintaining and enhancing end\-to\-end services for our DEX solution deployed in Azure
* Align the team’s product roadmap in collaboration with Product Management
* Review the top items in Product Backlog, ensure they are well\-understood with clear description and acceptance criteria (breaking them down to smaller stories or creating spikes to understand them better) so that the team can story\-point them properly during Sprint Planning
* Work with the Product Owner/Product Manager to finalize the Sprint Backlog for each Sprint, by prioritizing the different workloads \- Product (Feature) roadmap; Customer requests and Sustain cases; Security vulnerabilities; Technical Debt; ad\-hoc work requests
* Be the single point of contact for all stakeholders (Product Management, Customer Support, Security team, SRE, other engineering teams, etc) to prevent disruptions to the team members
* Own all parts of the service lifecycle, including design, development, documentation, testing, tracking and operations
* Continuously improve the product delivery process
* Deliver software meeting highest quality in terms of usability, stability, performance and security
* Be responsible for the quality the product the team delivers, as well as their overall effectiveness
* Utilize proven technical best practices to inspire and guide the team, ensure that their solutions can be used by other teams in an easy and flexible manner
* Ensure the personal and professional development of the team members to help them reach their full potential
* Provide guidance in regards to technical, process, or method\-related questions to the team, and enable and foster a culture of open feedback and communication


**Requirements**
* A university or college degree in the field of Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems or a related subject
* 10\+ years of software development experience on Product Development (on C\# .Net \& SQL – experience in Azure is a plus), with at least 2 years as Team Lead / Team Manager for an Agile team
* Experience contributing to cross\-team initiatives, coordinating with other team leads and team members (both remote and in\-person)
* Comfortable with working in high\-demand set\-up and ability to prioritize execution, hands\-on mentality
* Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing and operations
* Experience partnering with product and user experience teams
* Solid knowledge of Secure SDLC principles, OWASP Top\-10 vulnerabilities \& remediation, and Threat Modeling
* Strong communication skills to customers, business and technical partners
* Strong data\-driven mindset and a great attention to detail
* A pragmatic, outcome\-focused mindset that balances technical excellence with business needs and delivery timelines.
* A spirit of lifelong learning and eagerness to tackle new challenges every day
* Technical background is a plus \- experience in Docker, Kafka, DataBricks, ADO pipelines or Azure services (like AKS, Redis, Keyvault, EventHub, ServiceBus, SQL MI etc)
* Domain knowledge in end\-user computing and/or DEX is a plus
* Fluency in English is mandatory, further languages are a plus


 TeamViewer is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome and supported. We C\-A\-R\-E and understand that our diverse, values\-driven culture makes us stronger. As we continue to grow as a company, we also focus on enabling our employees to grow both personally and professionally. We are proud to have an open and embracing workplace environment that will empower you to be your best no matter your gender, civil or family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

title: US Proposal Specialist / Proposal Writer
description:
**US PROPOSAL SPECIALIST** 




  





 Acro Service Corporation, Bid and Proposal Team
 



  





**Experience: 3\+** 
 Years
 



**Shift:** 
**Night Shift (7:30 PM \-4:30 AM IST)** 




**Location:** 
 Noida Sector 68 (Onsite)
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Acro Service Corporation (Acro) is seeking an experienced Proposal Specialist to join its Bid and Proposal team, supporting Acro's US staffing, MSP, VMS, and workforce solutions business from India. The Proposal Specialist is a hands\-on individual contributor and full member of the proposal team, responsible for managing assigned Complex and Express RFx opportunities from initial review through final submission. This is a fast paced, high ownership role covering the full response lifecycle, from initial solicitation assessment and Go No Go input through response planning, strategy sessions, content development, reviews, and final compliance and submission.
 



 Complex RFx are large, formal solicitations, typically from state and local governments and large commercial buyers, that require a full response plan, strategy sessions, and multiple contributors. Express bids are smaller, quick turn solicitations that one person can typically assess, assemble, and submit within a few days.
 



 The role calls for strong project management, judgment, and follow through: anticipating what is needed next, following up independently with contributors, and moving assigned responses forward without continuous direction, while working within Acro's proposal SOPs and escalating when a leadership decision is required. Solicitations carry strict compliance and submission requirements, and a single missed instruction can disqualify a bid, so close reading and attention to detail are essential.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



1. **Manage assigned Complex and Express RFx responses from beginning to end.** 
 Review the solicitation, build the compliance checklist and response plan, coordinate meetings and inputs, develop the response from approved Acro content tailored to the issuer's requirements, and drive it through final submission.
2. **Contribute to Go No Go and response strategy.** 
 Conduct the initial opportunity review, facilitate assigned strategy discussions, and recommend relevant Acro capabilities, experience, and proof points.
3. **Apply proposal and workforce solutions expertise.** 
 Build working knowledge of Acro's staffing, MSP, VMS, RPO, technical and consulting, and related services; use standard content only where it actually answers the requirement; and escalate pricing, contractual, legal, or significant solution decisions to the appropriate owner.
4. **Project manage assigned responses within the proposal SOP.** 
 Own timelines, dependencies, reviews, and approvals; anticipate bottlenecks; and apply the team's checklists, templates, and quality controls consistently.
5. **Manage proposal meetings and SME contributions.** 
 Facilitate kickoff, strategy, working, and review sessions, and obtain complete input from leadership, business development, operations, finance, legal, and subject matter experts, following up persistently until it is received.
6. **Develop, tailor, and integrate proposal content.** 
 Draft and edit clear, accurate, persuasive content aligned to the evaluation criteria, and integrate input from multiple contributors into one consistent response.
7. **Ensure compliance, quality, and submission readiness.** 
 Track every mandatory requirement, form, and submission instruction, and conduct thorough final compliance and quality reviews before submission.
8. **Track and interpret solicitation changes.** 
 Monitor amendments, addenda, and Q\&A, summarize their impact, and update the response accordingly.
9. **Maintain proposal content, references, and document control.** 
 Keep proposal content, templates, references, and past performance current, and maintain SharePoint organization, version control, and RFx Tracker status for assigned bids.
10. **Support continuous improvement and team priorities.** 
 Recommend practical process and content improvements, contribute to business development collateral, and collaborate on other team responses during peak periods.



  





**Requirements** 








* Demonstrated experience managing bids or proposals from solicitation review through content coordination, compliance, production, approvals, and final submission.
* Ability to manage both quick turn and complex responses with multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and shifting deadlines.
* Experience facilitating proposal kickoff, strategy, and review meetings and converting decisions into actions and content.
* Strong critical thinking and judgment, with the ability to interpret requirements and evaluation criteria, identify gaps and risks, and recommend practical next steps.
* Excellent written English with strong writing, editing, and proofreading skills, and the ability to adapt tone and level of detail to different buyers.
* Demonstrated attention to detail, including experience with compliance matrices and formal submission requirements.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to obtain information from busy subject matter experts and drive accountability respectfully.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Word, including styles, tables, and templates, and working proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.
* Ability to work U.S. Eastern business hours and communicate clearly and promptly with U.S. based colleagues.
* Familiarity with U.S. government procurement portals, SAM.gov, and cooperative contracts is strongly preferred.

title: BIM Engineer - Building Technology Systems
description:
**Job Description**
 We are seeking a talented and motivated BIM Engineer specializing in Building Technology Systems (ICT, Audio Visual, Security, BMS) to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for the development, implementation, and management of Building Information Modeling (BIM) strategies in our projects. This position requires proficiency in BIM software, a solid understanding of building technology systems, and excellent collaboration skills to work effectively with architects, engineers, and other stakeholders.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop and maintain detailed BIM models for building technology systems, including ICT, Security, Audio\-Visua, and telecommunications.
* Collaborate with design teams to ensure integration of various building systems within the BIM environment.
* Conduct clash detection and resolution using BIM software to minimize system conflicts during the design phase.
* Provide technical support and guidance to project teams regarding best practices in BIM implementation and workflows.
* Ensure the accuracy and consistency of BIM documentation, including drawings, specifications, and project reports.
* Assist in the development and execution of BIM execution plans, including defining project goals, processes, and deliverables.
* Stay up\-to\-date with industry trends, technologies, and software developments related to BIM and building technology systems.

* Provide training and mentorship to junior staff in BIM practices and software tools.

* Bachelor’s degree in Electronics \& Communications, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum of 4 years of experience in BIM coordination and management for building technology systems.
* Proficiency in BIM software such as Revit, Navisworks, AutoCAD, and other relevant design tools.
* Strong knowledge of building technology systems and their integration within architectural designs.
* Experience with clash detection and resolution processes in BIM\-driven projects.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects concurrently.
* Familiarity with industry standards, codes, and regulations related to building technology systems.
