title: Senior Project Manager HVDC
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 The Senior Project Manager – HVDC is responsible for leading the execution of large, complex High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) projects from contract award through commissioning and closeout. This role has full accountability for project performance across safety, quality, schedule, cost, risk, and customer satisfaction. The Senior Project Manager coordinates multidisciplinary teams including engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, commercial, and contract management functions to ensure successful project delivery in line with company objectives and contractual commitments and will report to the Project Director.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Project Leadership and Execution
* Lead with team end\-to\-end execution of HVDC projects, ensuring delivery in accordance with contract requirements, budget, schedule, and quality standards.
* Partner with Project Director to establish project execution strategy, governance, and delivery plans.
* Drive project performance across all phases including engineering, procurement, manufacturing, installation, testing, commissioning, and handover.
* Ensure alignment between project scope, execution methodology, and customer expectations.
* Manage internal and external project stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
* Provide leadership to cross\-functional and geographically dispersed project teams.
* Commercial and Financial Management
* Along with Project Director take ownership of project P\&L, cost control, margin protection, cash flow, and financial forecasting.
* Monitor project budgets, expenditures, contingencies, and billing milestones.
* Identify and manage changes in scope, claims, variation orders, and contractual entitlements.
* Ensure robust contract/commercial management in cooperation with finance, commercial, and contract management teams.
* Drive opportunities for cost optimization and operational efficiency.
* Schedule and Resource Management
* Support to develop and maintain integrated project schedules and key milestone plans.
* Support \& ensure appropriate allocation of project resources across engineering, supply chain, site execution, and commissioning activities.
* Monitor schedule progress and implement recovery plans when needed.
* Coordinate with functional managers to secure the required competencies and capacities for successful project delivery.
* Risk and Opportunity Management
* Lead identification, assessment, and mitigation of project risks and opportunities.
* Maintain project risk registers and ensure timely implementation of mitigation actions.
* Anticipate project execution challenges related to technology, interfaces, supply chain, construction, grid connection, and regulatory requirements.
* Escalate critical issues appropriately and propose practical solutions.
* Customer and Stakeholder Management
* Serve as the primary point of contact for the customer on all project execution matters.
* Build strong customer relationships and ensure high levels of satisfaction and trust.
* Lead customer meetings, project reviews, progress reporting, and executive\-level communications.
* Manage interfaces with consortium partners, subcontractors, suppliers, utilities, consultants, and regulatory authorities as applicable.
* Contract and Claims Management
* Ensure compliance with contractual obligations and project governance requirements.
* Support interpretation of contract terms, management of obligations, and administration of key notices.
* Lead or support preparation and negotiation of claims, extensions of time, and change requests.
* Work closely with legal and contract management teams to protect company interests.
* Quality, Safety, and Compliance
* Promote and enforce a strong culture of EHS (Environment, Health, and Safety) across all project activities.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, customer specifications, industry regulations, and applicable standards.
* Drive quality assurance and quality control throughout project execution.
* Ensure project lessons learned are captured and applied.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or related discipline.
* Master’s degree is an advantage.
* Project Management certification such as PMP, IPMA, or equivalent is preferred.


**Experience**
* 15\+ years of experience in project management, with significant experience in Large Infrastructure projects in the field of Transmission, Generation or O\&G. Experience in HVDC, FACTS technologies will be an added advantage.
* Proven track record of successfully delivering large, complex, multidisciplinary projects of \> $100 M.
* Must have experience of working on global contracts (in multiple geographies) and hands on experience of partnering \& working with global teams from various countries and cultures.
* Strong experience in managing customer contracts, project financials, risks, and claims.
* Experience in international project environments and matrix organizations preferred.
* Experience with utility, transmission system operator (TSO), or grid projects is highly desirable.


**Required Skills**
* Understanding of HVDC systems, power transmission projects, and large infrastructure delivery.
* Excellent project management capabilities across scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, and stakeholder management.
* Strong technical, commercial and contractual acumen.
* Leadership skills with the ability to manage large cross\-functional teams.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and customer relationship management skills.
* Proficiency with project planning, reporting, and financial management tools.
* Familiarity with EPC contract models and consortium project execution.
* Ability to manage multicultural and geographically distributed teams.
* Strong presentation and executive reporting skills.


******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:** 
 Yes

title: MS Dynamics NAV ERP Head
description:
**Company Description** 
 Metaflex Doors is a leading provider of high\-tech airtight and hermetic door systems serving global healthcare, cold chain, and life science markets. With over 50 years of experience, Metaflex is recognized worldwide for safety, reliability, and sustainable solutions that protect critical environments. The company offers a comprehensive portfolio of access solutions that enhance safety, hygiene, and operational efficiency, including custom doors for noise reduction, fire, smoke, radiation resistance, and temperature\-controlled areas. Metaflex is part of ASSA ABLOY, a global leader in access solutions, which enables access to an extensive range of automatic, commercial, industrial, and digital solutions. This group structure provides employees exposure to diverse technologies and markets and offers customers flexible, integrated solutions for optimizing their facilities.
   

**Role Description** 
 The MS Dynamics NAV ERP Head is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Noida, responsible for leading the implementation, optimization, and support of the company’s MS Dynamics NAV ERP environment. The role involves managing ERP configuration and customization, overseeing integrations with production, logistics, finance, and sales systems, and ensuring data integrity and process efficiency across all business functions. This position leads cross\-functional collaboration with operations, finance, supply chain, and management teams to translate business needs into effective ERP workflows, reports, and dashboards. Daily responsibilities include supervising ERP\-related projects, coordinating with external vendors and internal IT staff, resolving system issues, training users, and continuously improving demand, business, and production planning processes through the ERP platform. The ERP Head is also expected to establish governance, documentation, and best practices to support scalability and compliance.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong demand planning and analytical skills to forecast requirements, interpret data, and support decision\-making.
* Planning and business planning capabilities to design and optimize ERP\-supported processes across functions.
* Experience in production planning and coordination to align ERP workflows with manufacturing and supply chain operations.
* Advanced expertise in MS Dynamics NAV (or Business Central), including configuration, customization, and integration.
* Proven experience in leading ERP implementations or major upgrades in a manufacturing or industrial environment.
* Solid understanding of finance, inventory, and supply chain modules within ERP systems.
* Ability to manage cross\-functional stakeholders, prioritize requirements, and drive structured project delivery.
* Strong problem\-solving, documentation, and process mapping skills with attention to data accuracy and system reliability.
* Effective communication skills and the ability to train and support users at different levels of technical proficiency.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field; relevant ERP certifications are an advantage.

title: Staff Project Engineering Manager
description:
We Are
   

  

 Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
   

  

 You Are
   

  

 You have spent years managing ASIC and IC design projects where the stakes are real, timelines are tight, and the difference between a successful tapeout and a missed window is your ability to see around corners. You know that the hardest part of delivering complex IP is not just the technical work, it is keeping cross\-functional teams aligned when R\&D, Marketing, Sales, and customers all have different definitions of "done."
   

  

 You do not manage by status reports alone. You get into the details when a SerDes PHY design hits a roadblock, understand the technical tradeoffs well enough to ask the right questions, and work with your engineers to find a path forward that does not compromise quality or schedule. You have learned that risk management is not about spreadsheets, it is about knowing which risks to escalate, which to mitigate quietly, and which conversations to have before they become problems.
   

  

 You are the kind of leader who can translate a customer's vague requirement into a concrete project scope, push back when timelines do not match reality, and still maintain trust on all sides. You care about process, but only when it makes the team faster and more effective, not for its own sake.
   

  

 At Synopsys, you will lead SerDes PHY IP projects that power the next generation of high\-speed connectivity in everything from data centers to automotive systems. The work is technical, the teams are global, and what you deliver will ship in products that matter.
   

  

 What You'll Be Doing
   

  

* Manage end\-to\-end delivery of high\-speed SerDes PHY IP projects from definition through tapeout and customer deployment
* Lead cross\-functional project teams including design engineers, verification engineers, and layout specialists to execute against aggressive schedules
* Partner with R\&D and Marketing to define project roadmaps, prioritize features, and align technical deliverables with market requirements
* Identify resource gaps, manage project risks, and resolve cross\-team dependencies before they block progress
* Drive process improvements across the engineering organization, implementing best practices that reduce cycle time and improve quality
* Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Support teams on pre\-sales technical engagement and post\-sales issue resolution
* Deliver regular status updates to executive leadership and customers, translating technical progress into business outcomes


 The Impact You Will Have
   

  

* Accelerate time\-to\-market for advanced SerDes IP that enables high\-speed connectivity in AI, automotive, and data center applications
* Enable customers to meet increasingly complex design requirements with proven, high\-quality IP that integrates cleanly into their SoCs
* Strengthen Synopsys' reputation as a trusted partner for mission\-critical semiconductor IP through consistent on\-time, on\-spec delivery
* Improve engineering efficiency across the organization by identifying bottlenecks and implementing scalable processes that work across multiple projects
* Foster tighter collaboration between R\&D, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Support, ensuring alignment from early concept through customer deployment
* Contribute directly to Synopsys' leadership position in high\-speed interface IP, supporting customers building the next generation of smart, connected devices
* Mentor project leads and engineers on your team, building organizational capability in technical program management and cross\-functional leadership


 What You'll Need
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field with 8\+ years of relevant experience, or Master's/PhD with 6\+ years
* Deep technical knowledge of IC design, ASIC development flows, and semiconductor IP integration, particularly in mixed\-signal or SerDes domains
* Proven track record leading complex engineering projects in a high\-tech environment, ideally in semiconductor IP or ASIC development
* Strong risk management and change management skills, with experience navigating technical uncertainty and scope changes without derailing schedules
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, you can explain technical tradeoffs to executives and translate customer requirements into actionable engineering plans
* Experience with SerDes PHY IP, high\-speed interface standards like PCIe, USB, or Ethernet is a strong plus
* Familiarity with project management methodologies and tools, whether Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid approaches tailored to hardware development


 Who You Are
   

  

* You can walk into a project review, quickly assess whether the team is on track or at risk, and ask the two questions that get to the real issue
* When a customer escalation lands on your desk, you do not panic or deflect, you pull the right people together, get to root cause, and own the path to resolution
* You are comfortable pushing back on unrealistic timelines or under\-scoped requirements, but you do it in a way that builds trust rather than defensiveness
* You see process improvement as a means to an end, not a goal in itself, and you know the difference between a process that helps and one that just adds overhead
* You are detail\-oriented enough to catch a missed dependency in a project plan, but strategic enough to keep the team focused on what actually moves the needle
* You adapt quickly when priorities shift, resources change, or a technical assumption turns out to be wrong, and you help your team do the same without losing momentum


 The Team You'll Be Part Of
   

  

 Join our Mixed\-Signal Semiconductor IP team, a collaborative group driving innovation in high\-speed SerDes solutions for next\-generation devices.
   

  

 Rewards and Benefits
   

  

 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

title: Senior Lead, Information Technology (IT) and System Support
description:
Are you a change maker who wants to play a pivotal role in restoring vision for millions of people in low\-income settings across India? Would you like to work for an organisation that is a pioneer in social impact practices?
 





 We are seeking a highly motivated, dynamic, and self\-driven candidate who would like to have a challenging and meaningful career path in information technology and the social sector. Information Technology (IT) is a key focus area in our organisation and requires a proactive and dynamic approach. The candidate should be dedicated and sincere towards her/his work and should always be open to learning new things. The candidate should have in\-depth subject matter knowledge, expertise, and experience. Timely and high\-quality delivery of goals would be essential and will be a key performance measurement criterion. S/he will be based out of Delhi NCR (Noida), India.
 




  





**About You** 



* You love all aspects of IT and are comfortable talking about WAPs, routers, and websites one minute, Microsoft Azure, SAP, and Salesforce the next, researching new technologies in the morning, and writing SOPs and meeting with developers in the afternoon.
* You enjoy working with cross\-functional teams to learn what their needs are and turn those needs into requirements and user stories/use cases.
* You enjoy working with programmers to build out the project/feature release plan.
* You are a team player and enjoy working with other IT professionals.
* You work well in an open planned environment and see everyone as an equal, no matter what their responsibilities are.
* You are flexible and adaptable and thrive in environments where each day is unlike the next.
* You operate with integrity and take pride in going above and beyond even when no one is watching.
* You love to start, run, and complete projects, no matter how big or small.
* You are excited to demonstrate your projects.
* You enjoy problem solving that requires research and development.
* You like to manage technology projects of any nature.




  
 




**About Us** 



* We are creating access to eyeglasses for low\-income people. Clear vision creates opportunities for increased learning, work, safety, civic participation, and quality of life.
* As a social organisation, social change motivates us first. Our focus is on advancing our mission objectives \- to increase functioning, productivity, and income earning potential for our low\-income people by correcting impaired vision with eyeglasses.
* We are working to transform the systemic dysfunction which has failed to deliver eyeglasses \- a 700\-year\-old technology \- to approximately 55 Crore people in India in need of vision correction.
* We serve low\-income people who are more than beneficiaries to us. The people (and the partners) we serve expect high\-quality eye\-screening and eyeglasses.
* To efficiently scale, we must deliver each new unit at less cost.
* We run our operations on financial metrics and social impact measures. We leverage a range of processes and practices to get the work done.
* We believe in scaling our impact, not our organisation. We are a lean team of doers.



  





**What You’ll Do** 





 You will be leading the IT department and the talented individuals that are part of the same. You will be responsible for providing management for the development and release of internal and external software projects and the management of system support and infrastructure operations. If you work well in an energising environment, have excellent communication, superb administrative and technical skills, can multi\-task under pressure, and are self\-motivated…we want you!
 




  





**Essential Functions** 



* Managing IT operations teams for internal system support and Azure cloud/LAN infrastructure.
* Planning and implementing projects ensuring timely and accurate communication and distribution of information, documentation, and issue resolution to all appropriate team members.
* Leading, facilitating, and tracking project deliverables using Agile and Waterfall methodologies.
* Overseeing QA/QC testing, user acceptance/adoption, and tools research and selection.
* Strong hands\-on experience in cybersecurity tools, risk mitigation, and compliance.
* Strong knowledge of ITIL framework.
* Administer and manage SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Microsoft 365 suite.
* Develop intranet portals, document management system, workflows (Power Automate), and permissions architecture.
* Manage SharePoint security, data retention policies, and integration with other work/operational apps.
* Drive user adoption and training for SharePoint and Teams.
* Budgeting, vendor management, license compliance, and IT asset management.
* Maintain IT documentation, SOPs, and IT risk register
* Providing program insights efficiently.
* Working with teams across multiple locations.
* Overseeing the programming team.
* Experiencing managing software development projects.



  





**What’s Required** 



* 15\+ years’ experience in IT operations and software product development.
* Fluent in reading, writing, and speaking English
* Experience in feature release planning, product charter, scope definition, requirements gathering, project planning, change control, risk management, and reporting.
* Ability to break down the requirements into user stories and can run the stories with the organisation to define the prioritisation.
* At least 3 years’ project management experience using Agile and Waterfall methodologies.
* Experience working with SAP B1 and Salesforce.
* Experience managing a website.
* Experience with the integration between various systems.
* Experience of working on multiple projects simultaneously.
* Ability to translate organisational requirements to technical documentation and artifacts.
* Ability to wireframe and prototype solutions.
* Strong understanding of SDLC and its phases.
* Ability to interact with users and translate needs maintainable configurations, extensions and customisations.
* Ability to set up source code management/release platform (GitHub)
* Ability to set up automated QC/QA testing.
* Experiencing managing IT teams.
* Experience with Zoho Sprint a plus.
* Working experience in database programming using RDBMS databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, others, etc.
* Exposure to Microsoft IIS.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure is a plus.
* Extraordinary follow\-through, attention to detail and deadlines, and a strong personal sense of accountability.
* The highest standards of ethics, with a demonstrated capacity for discretion and for handling sensitive information with care.
* Meaningful experience working as a part of a team and demonstrated success collaborating with external consultants to move projects forward.
* Quick learner and self\-driven.



  





**Compensation and Benefits** 



* Salary based on experience and education.
* Competitive benefits, including health insurance and generous vacation time.



  





**To Apply** 



* We want to know more than just what you have done. We want to know who you are. What are the passions and talents that draw you to this role?
* Please submit an application, including a thoughtful cover letter and your CV/resume, to:
 
 careers@visionspringfoundation.org
 
 . Please ensure there is a short description of each organisation on your CV/resume. Include your last name and “Senior Lead, Information Technology (IT) and System Support” in the subject line.
* Please note that only candidates to be interviewed will be contacted.
* Evaluation of qualified candidates will include an assessment exercise, which will be followed by a competency\-based interview.
* We are an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Project Manager – API & FinTech
description:
**Project Manager – API \& FinTech** 




**BeFiSc \| Full\-Time \| Noida Onsite** 




**Job Title :** 

 Project Manager – API \& FinTech
 




**Designation :** 

 Project Manager
 




**Department Team :** 

 Project Management / Technology
 




**Experience :** 

 3\+ Years
 




**Industry Experience :** 

 API / FinTech / BFSI / Technology
 




**Employment Type :** 

 Full\-Time
 




**Location :** 

 Noida – Onsite
 



**About BeFiSc** 


 BeFiSc is a financial data intelligence and risk technology company helping businesses make safer, faster, and smarter decisions. We work with organizations across FinTech, BFSI, Insurance, Digital Lending, and Financial Services.
 





 Our business is primarily API\-driven, providing technology and data solutions that enable businesses to integrate financial intelligence, verification, fraud prevention, and risk assessment capabilities directly into their platforms.
 





 Our core focus is Fraud Prevention, Risk Analysis, and Financial Data Intelligence. Using APIs, technology, data analytics, and large\-scale data processing, we help businesses verify customers and businesses, assess risk, detect suspicious patterns, and automate critical financial workflows.
 



**Role Overview** 


 We are looking for an experienced Project Manager – API \& FinTech who can take end\-to\-end ownership of API integrations, new API/product launches, enterprise client implementations, technical projects, and production\-related deliverables.
 





 The candidate should have a strong understanding of how REST APIs and API\-based businesses operate, including API documentation, authentication, request/response structures, webhooks, sandbox and production environments, UAT, go\-live, SLAs, latency, uptime, error handling, and production issue management.
 





 The Project Manager will act as a bridge between Clients, Product, Engineering, QA, DevOps, Information Security, Operations, Support, and Business teams.
 





 The role requires someone who can understand both the technical and business side of API integrations and ensure that projects move from requirement to production without unnecessary delays.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 
1. Take complete ownership of API development projects from initial requirement gathering through UAT, production go\-live, and post\-production monitoring.
2. Understand client requirements and map them to existing APIs, enhancements, or new product requirements.
3. Coordinate with Product and Engineering teams for new API development, API enhancements, integrations, and client\-specific requirements.
4. Understand API documentation including endpoints, HTTP methods, headers, authentication, request parameters, JSON responses, status codes, error codes, and webhooks.
5. Manage the complete API integration lifecycle: Requirement → Feasibility → Development → QA → Documentation → Staging/UAT → Client Testing → Production → Monitoring.
6. Coordinate sharing and management of staging credentials, production credentials, authentication keys, IP whitelisting, callback URLs, and environment configurations.
7. Ensure clients receive correct and updated API documentation, sample requests/responses, Postman collections, and integration instructions.
8. Track client integration progress and proactively follow up on pending actions from both internal teams and clients.
9. Maintain project trackers covering owner, priority, status, ETA, dependency, blocker, next action, and completion date.
10. Coordinate API testing with QA, Product, Engineering, and client teams before production release.
11. Manage UAT sign\-off and production go\-live readiness.
12. Track API performance and service commitments including uptime, success rate, latency, error rate, source\-down percentage, and SLA/TAT.
13. Coordinate production issues involving API failures, high latency, source downtime, incorrect responses, authentication failures, or integration issues.
14. Ensure critical production issues are escalated to the appropriate Engineering, DevOps, or Product teams based on severity.
15. Coordinate preparation of RCA (Root Cause Analysis) for major incidents and ensure corrective and preventive actions are tracked to closure.
16. Differentiate between client\-side issues, BeFiSc\-side issues, third\-party/source issues, and integration/configuration issues and coordinate accordingly.
17. Manage multiple enterprise client integrations and API projects simultaneously.
18. Conduct regular project and integration review meetings with internal stakeholders.
19. Maintain clear MoMs, action items, owners, timelines, and follow\-ups for client and internal meetings.
20. Identify project risks, technical dependencies, resource constraints, and potential delivery delays at an early stage.
21. Coordinate with Information Security and compliance teams where client integrations require security questionnaires, VAPT, IP whitelisting, data\-flow clarification, or other security requirements.
22. Provide regular project status reports to leadership highlighting completed items, pending integrations, delays, blockers, risks, and upcoming releases.


**Required Technical Understanding** 


 The candidate is not expected to be a developer, but should be technically strong enough to understand and manage API integrations independently.
 



* REST APIs and HTTP/HTTPS
* GET, POST, PUT/PATCH and DELETE methods
* JSON request and response structures
* Headers and query/path parameters
* HTTP status codes
* API authentication and API keys
* Bearer tokens / OAuth basics
* Webhooks and callback URLs
* IP whitelisting
* Staging/UAT and Production environments
* API timeout and retry mechanisms
* Rate limits
* API latency and response time
* Error handling and error codes
* Postman / cURL
* API documentation
* Basic database and cloud concepts
* Logs and basic API troubleshooting


**Required Skills** 
* Strong experience managing API or technology integration projects.
* Strong project planning and execution capabilities.
* Ability to understand technical API requirements and communicate them clearly.
* Strong client and stakeholder management.
* Excellent coordination with Engineering, Product, QA, DevOps, Support, and Business teams.
* Strong understanding of SDLC and Agile/Scrum.
* Experience with Jira or similar project management tools.
* Ability to manage multiple client integrations simultaneously.
* Strong documentation and requirement\-gathering skills.
* Strong follow\-up and dependency management.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Ability to work under pressure during production incidents.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* High ownership and accountability.


**Required Qualifications and Experience** 
* Minimum 3\+ years of Project Management / Technical Project Management experience.
* Experience working in an API\-first, SaaS, FinTech, BFSI, or technology company.
* Hands\-on experience managing API integrations or enterprise technology implementations.
* Experience working directly with technical teams and enterprise clients.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, Business, or a related field.
* Experience managing projects from requirement gathering through production go\-live.
* Experience handling multiple projects and stakeholders simultaneously.
* Good understanding of software development and API integration lifecycle.


**Preferred or Good to Have** 
* Prior experience in an API\-first FinTech company will be highly preferred.
* Experience working with FinTech, BFSI, Insurance, Digital Lending, RegTech, KYC, Verification, Fraud Prevention, or Financial Data products.
* Experience handling enterprise BFSI clients.
* Understanding of third\-party/source\-dependent APIs.
* Experience managing API uptime, latency, success rates, and SLAs.
* Experience coordinating production incidents and RCAs.
* Understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS.
* Basic understanding of databases such as MongoDB/PostgreSQL.
* Exposure to API security and information security requirements.
* PMP, Scrum, Agile, or similar certifications are an advantage.


**Key Performance Areas** 
* On\-time API integrations and project delivery.
* API integration TAT.
* Client onboarding and go\-live TAT.
* Percentage of projects delivered within committed timelines.
* Number and ageing of open blockers.
* SLA adherence.
* Timely escalation of project and production risks.
* Quality of project documentation and tracking.
* UAT and production readiness.
* Client communication and stakeholder management.
* Production incident coordination and RCA closure.
* Accuracy of project status reporting.
* Effective coordination between Product, Engineering, QA, DevOps, Support, and clients.


**Ideal Candidate Profile** 


 The ideal candidate should be technically aware, execution\-focused, structured, proactive, and comfortable dealing directly with enterprise clients.
 





 We are specifically looking for someone who understands that managing an API business is not simply about maintaining Jira tickets.
 





 The candidate should be capable of understanding a client's API requirement, discussing it with Engineering/Product, tracking development and testing, helping resolve integration blockers, coordinating UAT, managing production deployment, and ensuring successful go\-live.
 





 The candidate should also be comfortable managing situations where multiple clients, production issues, source dependencies, technical blockers, and urgent business priorities occur simultaneously. Strong ownership and follow\-up discipline will be critical for this role.
 



**Why Join BeFiSc** 
* Work in an API\-first FinTech and financial data intelligence company.
* Manage APIs used by FinTech, BFSI, Insurance, and Digital Lending organizations.
* Work on real\-world problems involving fraud prevention, risk assessment, verification, and financial intelligence.
* Gain exposure to large\-scale API transactions and enterprise integrations.
* Work closely with Engineering, Product, DevOps, Information Security, and business teams.
* Take end\-to\-end ownership of API implementations and enterprise client projects.
* Directly contribute to improving API uptime, latency, integration experience, and service delivery.




 At BeFiSc, the Project Manager will play a critical role in ensuring that API products move efficiently from requirement to development, integration, production, and successful client adoption.

**Position Title:** 
 Manager – Conversion Subject Matter Expert (Life Insurance \& Annuities Policy Administration Transformation)
   

  

**Function:** 
 Insurance
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bangalore / Chennai / Coimbatore / Kochi / Kolkata / Noida /Hyderabad / Pune / Trivandrum
   

  

 Role Summary
   

  

 The Conversion SME will own the end\-to\-end data and policy conversion strategy for a Life \& Annuities policy administration system transformation (e.g., legacy platform to FAST/Majesco/OIPA/FINEOS target). This role bridges business, actuarial, and technical teams to ensure accurate, compliant, and auditable migration of in\-force policy data, values, and transaction history from source to target systems.
   

  

 Key Roles \& Responsibilities
   

  

**Conversion Strategy \& Governance**
* Define the end\-to\-end conversion approach: crosswalk methodology, data mapping standards, tolerance thresholds, and reconciliation framework between legacy and target platforms.
* Own the conversion playbook — cutover strategy (big\-bang vs. phased/wave\-based), fallback/rollback plans, and freeze\-period governance.
* Establish data lineage documentation and version\-controlled mapping specs for audit and regulatory traceability.


**Business \& Technical Bridge**
* Translate legacy policy administration rules (billing, values, riders, beneficiaries, agent/commission structures) into target system configuration requirements.
* Partner with actuarial, IT, and QA teams to validate converted policy values (cash value, reserves, death benefit, surrender values) against source\-of\-truth calculations.
* Lead root\-cause analysis on conversion breaks/exceptions and drive remediation with configuration or ETL teams.


**Data Mapping \& Rules Definition**
* Author functional specifications for field\-level, transaction\-level, and history conversion (policy, billing, claims\-in\-progress, agent/commission, correspondence).
* Define exception handling rules for non\-standard policies, riders, or legacy product variants that don't map cleanly to the target chart of accounts/product model.
* Validate mapping specs with source system SMEs and target platform configuration leads.


**Testing \& Reconciliation**
* Design and oversee conversion test cycles (mock conversions, parallel runs, dress rehearsals) and define pass/fail acceptance criteria.
* Own policy\-level and aggregate\-level reconciliation reporting (financial tie\-outs, record counts, value tolerances) presented to governance/steering forums.
* Sign off on conversion readiness gates ahead of each cutover wave.


**Team \& Stakeholder Management**
* Lead and mentor a pod of conversion analysts/testers (onshore/offshore); manage workload, quality, and delivery timelines.
* Act as primary conversion point of contact for client business owners, actuarial, compliance, and IT conversion teams.
* Present conversion status, risk, and exception dashboards to steering committee/PMO.


**Compliance \& Risk**
* Ensure conversion approach aligns with regulatory requirements (state filings, policyholder notification rules, NAIC/IFRS 17 where applicable).
* Maintain audit trail documentation sufficient for internal audit and regulatory examination.


 Must\-Have Skills
   

  

**Category**
**Requirement**
**Domain**
 9
   

  

**Platform**
 Hands\-on conversion experience on at least one target PAS: FAST, Majesco, OIPA, FINEOS, or equivalent legacy modernization platform
   

  

**Conversion\-specific**
 Prior experience in at least one full PAS conversion/migration cycle — mapping, mock conversions, parallel testing, cutover
   

  

**Data**
 Strong SQL skills; experience with data mapping/ETL concepts; policy value reconciliation (cash value, reserves, COI, fund values for annuities)
   

  

**Documentation**
 Ability to write field\-level functional specs, mapping documents, and test scripts to consulting\-grade standards
   

  

**Delivery**
 Experience managing a pod, sprint/wave\-based delivery, and reporting into a governance/PMO structure
   

  

**Regulatory**
 Familiarity with state insurance regulations, policyholder notification requirements, and IFRS 17/statutory reporting impacts on conversion
   

  

**Preferred Skills**
* Prior Big 4/IT Service Company or systems integrator consulting background
* Experience with both Life and Annuities product lines (not just one)
* Exposure to agile delivery frameworks (Scrum/SAFe) in a conversion pod context
* Group Benefits conversion exposure (cross\-domain flexibility)
* Vendor\-side experience (e.g., having worked at a FAST/Majesco/FINEOS implementation partner)


**Credentials/Certifications (Preferred, Not Mandatory)**
* LOMA certifications relevant to conversion/operations
* CSPO® / PMP® / Prosci (change management) for delivery\-side credibility

title: Process Architect - Lead
description:
Join us as a “Process Architect – Lead” at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness key process reengineering concepts with cutting\-edge technology to revolutionize our digital offerings, ensuring unapparelled customer experiences.
   

  

 To be a successful "Process Architect \- Lead", you should have experience with:
   

  

  

* Any Graduate/Post Graduate
* Analysis and problem\-solving (process focussed preferred)
* Stakeholder management across different organisation levels (C\-level to junior)
* Process Mapping/ Modelling tools e.g. Blueworks, Visio.
* A positive ‘can\-do’ attitude.
* Knowledge of process reengineering and analysis.
* Working knowledge of process automation tools.
* Ability to work successfully in a matrix organisation structure with dual reporting
* Experience of working in a project team (as a lead).


**Desirable Skills/Preferred Qualifications**
* Ability to review processes, engage with SMEs, and identify process risks and challenges.
* Familiarity with process design concepts, and ability to recognise automation opportunities and provide recommendations as part of optimisation review.
* Experience in working as a business analyst in technology projects.
* Comfortable operating in a dynamic environment and thinking on your feet.


 You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as experience with process reengineering as well as job\-specific skillsets.
   

  

 Location \- Noida.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To collaborate with stakeholders and use data and MI to identify process optimisation opportunities for capacity creation in relevant business areas.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Development and implementation of strategies to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of banking operations, using data led insights.
* Participation in projects and initiatives to improve performance \& optimisation efficiency and effectiveness.
* Development of reports and presentations on performance \& optimisation and communicate findings to internal senior stakeholders.
* Identification of industry trends and developments, and collaboration with stakeholders across the bank to provide recommendations for change and improvement within performance and optimisation processes.
* Development and implementation of analytics and reporting performance \& optimisation to mitigate risks and maintain efficient operations.
* Identification of capacity creation in operations using data and Management Information.


**Vice President Expectations**
* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi\-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In\-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.
